## Infrastructure Layers

### Compute

| Component | Type | Test Requirements | Resilience Tests | Security Surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identity services | GKE (Kubernetes) | Pod health, readiness probes | Pod failure + recovery, rolling update | Network policy, mTLS |
| Payment services | GKE | Pod health, HPA scaling | Pod failure, memory pressure | Network policy |
| Auth gateway | Cloud Run | Cold start latency, concurrency | Cold start under load | IAM, TLS |
| Event processors | Cloud Functions | Execution time, timeout | Function timeout, retry | IAM |
| <!-- AGENT: add from arch diagram --> | | | | |

### Data

| Component | Type | Test Requirements | Resilience Tests | Security Surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accounts DB | CloudSQL (PostgreSQL) | Read/write integrity, decimal precision | Failover, connection pool exhaustion | IAM, VPC, encryption |
| Session store | Firestore | Read/write latency, TTL expiry | Failover | IAM |
| Analytics | BigQuery | Query correctness, schema validation | N/A | IAM, column-level security |
| Async events | Pub/Sub | Publish/consume flow, dead letter | Consumer lag under load | IAM, message ordering |
| Streaming | Kafka | Produce/consume flow, offset tracking | Consumer lag, partition failure | mTLS, ACL |
| <!-- AGENT: add from arch diagram --> | | | | |

### Networking

| Component | Type | Test Requirements | Resilience Tests | Security Surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| API Gateway | Cloud Endpoints / Apigee | Routing, rate limiting, timeout | Timeout + retry behaviour | Auth, rate limit |
| Load Balancer | GCP LB | Health check routing | Unhealthy backend removal | TLS termination |
| CDN | Cloud CDN | Cache hit/miss, invalidation | Stale cache on deploy | |
| Service mesh | Istio / Traffic Director | mTLS enforcement, traffic policy | Circuit breaker | mTLS, policy |
| VPC | GCP VPC | Network policy enforcement | N/A | Firewall rules, private IPs |
| <!-- AGENT: add from arch diagram --> | | | | |

## Infrastructure Test Requirements Summary

| Layer | Integration Tests | Chaos/Resilience Tests | Security Tests | Performance Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Compute (GKE) | Yes | Yes — pod failure, rolling update | Yes — network policy | Yes — HPA scaling |
| Compute (Cloud Run) | Yes | Yes — cold start | Yes — IAM | Yes — concurrency |
| Data (CloudSQL) | Yes | Yes — failover | Yes — encryption | Yes — connection pool |
| Data (Pub/Sub) | Yes | Yes — consumer lag | Yes — IAM | Yes — throughput |
| Networking (API GW) | Yes | Yes — timeout/retry | Yes — rate limit, auth | Yes — latency |
| Third-party (ForgeRock) | Yes | Yes — unavailable | Yes — token security | No |
| Third-party (Daon) | Yes | Yes — sandbox failure | Yes — PII in transit | No |
